output.brief:
The crash gap is mostly a build 7.4.0 problem, not a Tiled Canvas problem. On 7.4.0, crashes were already about 2% on 2–3 Sep, before the flag ramped. Build 7.3.2 stayed at about 0.7% throughout. Only 7.4.0 users can get the flag, so flagged users are all on 7.4.0. Within 7.4.0, flag-on users crash at 2.10% against 1.98% for the random flag-off holdout. That 0.12-point difference is within noise. Device mix and usage are the same across groups. The crash-reporting counts are confirmed by the app-store console, so this isn't a counting artifact. The sync-service deploy didn't change 7.3.2 rates. The leading 7.4.0 crash is a native crash in the upgraded Pixelda image library (HEIF decoding), with no canvas frames in the crash reports.

Don't do the plan as written. Turning the flag off won't fix the crashes, and sending 7.4.0 to 100% would spread them. Hold the rollout at 25% and fix the Pixelda crash. Keep the existing holdout running, or widen it, to settle whether the flag adds a small effect of a few tenths of a point. Confidence is high on the build being the driver, and moderate on the flag's small effect.
